top_signals.title: Israel strikes Lebanon as U.S. prepares fresh Iran sanctions
top_signals.summary: Israel said that it killed a senior Hezbollah commander raising the strikes' death toll to 11 — the deadliest since the ceasefire began.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hormuz Traffic Dwindles As US Threatens Economic Pressure
top_signals.summary: Transit through the Strait of Hormuz appeared to grind to a near standstill on Friday after two more ships were attacked there and the United States said it could maintain a naval blockade of Iran indefinitely.A senior Iranian source said on…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ethereum devs to narrow 66 proposals tied to Hegotá upgrade
top_signals.summary: The Hegotá upgrade aims to introduce more native privacy for Ethereum applications.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Flock tightens privacy controls amid scandals over officer abuse
top_signals.summary: All Flock Safety customers will be required to adopt its "Audit Assistance" feature for tracking abnormal uses, and the company says it will hold license plate data for only seven days in most cases.
